reason: Drizzle Kit legacy loader uses transform, not the vulnerable esbuild development server. No esbuild serve endpoint is exposed. Upstream loader replacement requires a separate compatibility check; a cross-major override is not applied.

Xcode project tooling uses random UUIDs for local project identifiers, not authorization or untrusted buffer writes. The installed CLI retains uuid 7 through xcode; forcing uuid 11 changes the dependency contract. Recheck upstream xcode support before mobile distribution.
